Demucs htdemucs_ft weights notice

Model: htdemucs_ft (four stems: drums, bass, other, vocals)

Code licence: MIT. The pretrained weights are a separate artifact. The upstream

research use only. They were trained on MUSDB18-HQ, a research corpus.
